https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/363 - https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/375 - https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/378 **User story:** Owners choose per repo whether autopilot merges alone or waits for their approval, which stays the default. **Acceptance criteria** - **Acceptance criterion:** With the auto-merge setting unset or off, a pull request whose code review passed waits for the owner's approval. - * Verified by: By default, a passed code review leaves the pull request waiting for your approval.* - Edge cases: The setting was never set. · The setting is off. · GitHub fails to read the setting. - **Acceptance criterion:** When on, Dokima's app merges a passed, green pull request directly, only once its branch holds main's newest commit. - * Verified by: With the setting on, Dokima merges a passed, green, up-to-date pull request by itself.* - Edge cases: A code review that blocks merges nothing. · GitHub refuses the bypass: the pull request waits and the owner sees GitHub's reason. · A red check on its head: nothing merges and the owner sees which check. · Its branch misses main's newest commit: nothing merges and the owner is told so in words. · It changes a workflow file: it still waits for the owner. - **Acceptance criterion:** With the setting on, the setup audit reports when Dokima's app lacks the merge queue's pull-request-only bypass. - * Verified by: With auto-merge on, the audit reports Dokima's app missing from the merge queue bypass.* - Edge cases: The app is on the bypass list: nothing is reported. · The setting is off or unset: nothing is reported. · GitHub refuses to list the rulesets: the audit says it could not verify them, and why. **Scope:** `dokima/agent.py`, `dokima/audit.py`, `dokima/manifest.py`, `dokima/app.json`, `AGENTS.md`
Original issue In Reza's words: "yes let autopilot merge alone but what if someone wants hitl mandatory for merge gate thats why i thought default behavior is hitl and you can turn on autopilot approval setting", and "allow bot approve for me with some narrow privilege". Verified on dokima-dev/merge-sandbox (same rules as main) on Oct 12: - Today Dokima's app cannot merge alone: the queue path waits on "review required" and a direct merge is refused by the merge queue. - With the app added to the merge-queue ruleset as a bypass actor limited to pull requests, plus its existing review bypass, the app's direct merge succeeds with no review. - GitHub still refuses that merge while a required check is missing, and still refuses any direct push to main. Done when - With the repo variable DOKIMA_AUTO_MERGE unset or off (the default), a pull request waits for the owner's approval, as today. - With DOKIMA_AUTO_MERGE=on, a pull request whose code review passed, whose required checks are green on its head and whose branch contains main's newest commit is merged by Dokima's app directly; one that changes a workflow file still waits for the owner. - With DOKIMA_AUTO_MERGE=on, the setup audit reports when the app is missing from the merge-queue ruleset's pull-request-only bypass list.
**Definition of Done:** All tests · Code review · Owner approval

https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/363 - https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/375 - https://github.com/dokima-dev/dokima/issues/378 **User story:** Owners choose per repo whether autopilot merges alone or waits for their approval, which stays the default. **Acceptance criteria** - **Acceptance criterion:** With the auto-merge setting unset or off, a pull request whose code review passed waits for the owner's approval. - * Verified by: By default, a passed code review leaves the pull request waiting for your approval.* - Edge cases: The setting was never set. · The setting is off. · GitHub fails to read the setting. - **Acceptance criterion:** When on, Dokima's app merges a passed, green pull request directly, only once its branch holds main's newest commit. - * Verified by: With the setting on, Dokima merges a passed, green, up-to-date pull request by itself.* - Edge cases: A code review that blocks merges nothing. · GitHub refuses the bypass: the pull request waits and the owner sees GitHub's reason. · A red check on its head: nothing merges and the owner sees which check. · Its branch misses main's newest commit: nothing merges and the owner is told so in words. · It changes a workflow file: it still waits for the owner. - **Acceptance criterion:** With the setting on, the setup audit reports when Dokima's app lacks the merge queue's pull-request-only bypass. - * Verified by: With auto-merge on, the audit reports Dokima's app missing from the merge queue bypass.* - Edge cases: The app is on the bypass list: nothing is reported. · The setting is off or unset: nothing is reported. · GitHub refuses to list the rulesets: the audit says it could not verify them, and why. **Scope:** `dokima/agent.py`, `dokima/audit.py`, `dokima/manifest.py`, `dokima/app.json`, `AGENTS.md`
Original issue In Reza's words: "yes let autopilot merge alone but what if someone wants hitl mandatory for merge gate thats why i thought default behavior is hitl and you can turn on autopilot approval setting", and "allow bot approve for me with some narrow privilege". Verified on dokima-dev/merge-sandbox (same rules as main) on Oct 12: - Today Dokima's app cannot merge alone: the queue path waits on "review required" and a direct merge is refused by the merge queue. - With the app added to the merge-queue ruleset as a bypass actor limited to pull requests, plus its existing review bypass, the app's direct merge succeeds with no review. - GitHub still refuses that merge while a required check is missing, and still refuses any direct push to main. Done when - With the repo variable DOKIMA_AUTO_MERGE unset or off (the default), a pull request waits for the owner's approval, as today. - With DOKIMA_AUTO_MERGE=on, a pull request whose code review passed, whose required checks are green on its head and whose branch contains main's newest commit is merged by Dokima's app directly; one that changes a workflow file still waits for the owner. - With DOKIMA_AUTO_MERGE=on, the setup audit reports when the app is missing from the merge-queue ruleset's pull-request-only bypass list.
**Definition of Done:** All tests · Code review · Owner approval
